method: Closed scattered-field surface flux divided by homogeneous incident intensity, versus direct analytic Mie series. Matched empty-box reference, unchanged physical domain/PML/time.

warnings: TFSF boxes use normal-incidence live Yee lines and a homogeneous background shell. Inside is total field, outside is scattered field. Amplitude scales the auxiliary soft drive. Check incident PML, mesh and time convergence before quantitative scattering.
Stored frames alias the carrier: 0.0 frames per optical period (period 135.6 steps, one frame every 10000 steps). The playback will look like backward motion; store a frame at least every 34 steps.
sample_summary.epsilon_definition: instantaneous relative permittivity (epsilon-infinity for dispersive cells)
sample_summary.units: geometry: um; time: s; E/H: reduced fields; Bloch phase: rad
